Method of Attack: Infecting victims by hacking into Windows computers running publicly accessible Remote Desktop services
Installing ransomware on all accessible computers on the network
Using PsExec to install ransomware on other computers in the network
Encrypting files with AES-256 encryption and appending .GOTYA extension
Creating ransom note RECOVERY.txt with bitcoin address, victim ID, payment instructions, and contact email
Passing encryption key as command line argument
Impacted Systems: Windows computers running publicly accessible Remote Desktop services
